### iRhythm Announces Approval of $200 Million Share Repurchase Program


11/11/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/296879096/files/doc_news/iRhythm-Announces-Approval-of-200-Million-Share-Repurchase-Program-2026.pdf)


SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- iRhythm Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: IRTC), a leading digital health care company with a mission to create trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease, today announced that on November 10, 2026, its Board of Directors approved a share repurchase program with authorization to purchase up to $200 million of the company’s outstanding common stock.


The approval reflects iRhythm’s confidence in the continued strength of its core business, as well as its significant new growth opportunities from the addition of the recently acquired VitalConnect business.


Repurchases under the program may be made in the open market, in privately negotiated transactions, through accelerated share repurchase transactions or by other methods, with the amount and timing of repurchases to be determined at the company’s discretion, depending on market conditions and corporate needs. Open market repurchases will be structured to occur in accordance with applicable federal and state securities laws, including within the pricing and volume conditions of Rule 10b-18 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. The company may also, from time to time, enter into Rule 10b5-1 plans to facilitate repurchases of its shares under this authorization. This program does not obligate the company to repurchase any particular dollar amount or number of shares of common stock and may be modified, suspended or terminated at any time at the discretion of its Board of Directors.


The company expects to fund repurchases with existing cash and cash equivalents and ongoing cash from operations.


**About iRhythm Holdings, Inc.**


iRhythm is a leading digital health care company with a mission to create trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease. Combining wearable biosensors and cloud-based data analytics with powerful proprietary algorithms, iRhythm distills data from millions of heartbeats into clinically actionable information. Through a relentless focus on patient care, iRhythm's vision is to deliver better data, better insights, and better health for all. For more information, visit[www.irhythmtech.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bzaUx5GfEEMjeE_wl0IHns36zUkJNhtCUvrGU72oNy0ts9s6srnk00o9w_FH5B6MOyIJfgwr9irKPokEi3G2_zg4M-IrmbqPzQi9ooxeGSU=) .
